items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by a general Hamburg authority (Bezirksamt, not Finanzamt). Delivery fiction per § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG: 4th day after posting = 19.11 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Sunday). For non-tax authorities the delivery day does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend/holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 BGB analog) and ends on the day with the same calendar number one month later (§188 Abs.2 BGB): 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Hamburg, so no shift under §31 Abs.3 HmbVwVfG/§193 BGB applies. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.
